head: Samsung's Tap to Share arrives in the One UI 9.5 beta for Galaxy S26
dek: Tap to Share, which sends files by touching the backs of two unlocked phones, is in Quick Share in the One UI 9.5 beta for the Galaxy S26 series, which has reached users in six countries, Android Headlines reports; both phones need NFC, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on. Samsung hasn't said when it comes to other phones.
